mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 index level during late-cycle expansion signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth trend (GDPC1) above 15,000 billion dollars indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 15,000.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 230 index level signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS) above 136,000 thousand and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signal robust labor market and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength and monetary ease
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 136,000 and FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 800 thousand units during housing market recovery signals increased consumer confidence and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 800 during housing market recovery.
